definitions.explanation: Oil extracted from plants, including seeds, nuts, and fruits. Used for cooking, food production, and industrial purposes. Contrasted with animal fats.

examples.japanese: {植物油|しょくぶつゆ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{揚|あ}げる→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{植物油|しょくぶつゆ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Vegetable oil is used in these snacks.

examples.japanese: {動物性|どうぶつせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{脂肪|しぼう}→脂肪：03199_shibou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{植物油|しょくぶつゆ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}き{換|か}える→置き換える：08226_okikaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that replacing animal fats with vegetable oil is good for your health.

notes: Common types of {植物油|しょくぶつゆ} include {大豆油|だいずゆ} (soybean oil), {菜種油|なたねあぶら} (rapeseed/canola oil), ⟦オリーブ→オリーブ：10808_oriibu⟧{油|ゆ} (olive oil), ⟦{胡麻油|ごまあぶら}→胡麻油：04919_gomaabura⟧ (sesame oil), and ココナッツ{油|ゆ} (coconut oil). Often appears on food ingredient labels (⟦{原材料|げんざいりょう}→原材料：18966_genzairyou⟧). Contrasted with {動物油|どうぶつゆ} (animal fat/oil). Compare with ⟦{食用油|しょくようゆ}→食用油：19158_shokuyouyu⟧ (cooking oil — broader, includes any oil for eating). Also read as しょくぶつあぶら in some contexts.
